themes.title: Far-Right Momentum and Electoral Contestation Ahead of Major Votes
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe are ramping up campaign machinery and contesting national and municipal elections with strong momentum. From Vox launching its general election campaign in Spain to Reform UK securing local by-election victories and the AfD fielding high-profile presidential candidates, nationalist and populist movements are demonstrating persistent electoral strength.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Kicks off its 29N general election campaign with high-profile TV debates, platform rollouts, and rallies.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Rallies supporters and positions party leadership for the 2027 presidential race amidst aggressive media appearances.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Fields former World Cup winner Thomas Berthold as its Federal President candidate while expanding state electoral efforts.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Surges in poll barometers while promoting sweeping spending cuts ahead of upcoming parliamentary elections.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Secures key council by-election victories while actively disputing seats in former Labour and Conservative strongholds.

themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Hardline right-wing parties are escalating national preference language and anti-immigration platforms as central remedies for domestic crises. Conservative leaders across Spain, the UK, the US, France, and Germany directly link mass migration to failing housing markets, depressed wages, public safety concerns, and welfare strain.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Frames mass immigration as the key driver behind housing scarcity, stagnant wages, and unsustainable public pensions during televised debates.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Campaigns aggressively against housing asylum seekers in local communities and demands an end to municipal funding for migrants.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Promotes record deportation numbers and hardline border enforcement mechanisms as flagship administrative policies.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Demands a national referendum on immigration to establish strict border and citizenship controls.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Navigates internal factional debates over hardline remigration agendas and forced deportation thresholds.

themes.title: Anti-Establishment Hostility to Public Media and Information Control
themes.blurb: Right-wing leaders across several countries are intensifying opposition against EU digital regulations, state media institutions, and platform moderation rules. By framing content governance and digital safety bills as institutional censorship, these movements present themselves as defenders of free expression.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: President Nawrocki vetoes the EU Digital Services Act bill, warning against state censorship and digital overreach.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Alleges targeted censorship and digital suppression by mainstream media and public broadcasting bodies.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Clashes with Supreme Court rulings regarding social media account blocks and allegations of judicial media manipulation.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Rival political factions trade accusations over state media bias, suppressed political archives, and information control.

themes.title: Transnational Right-Wing Networking and Parallel Diplomacy
themes.blurb: Populist and conservative parties are actively reinforcing international alliances to project political strength and influence cross-border narratives. High-profile endorsements and independent diplomatic maneuvers allow right-wing figures to bypass official state-to-state diplomatic protocol.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: President Javier Milei sends a video message to Vox's campaign opening in Madrid, calling for a unified crusade against socialism.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Highlights solidarity messages from international partners in Argentina and Italy to inaugurate its national campaign.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Giorgia Meloni sends supportive communications to Vox's rally while carrying out high-level foreign talks with Ukraine.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen conducts parallel foreign outreach by offering to meet directly with Ukrainian President Zelensky.

themes.title: Judicial Crackdowns and Surveillance Targeting the Far-Right
themes.blurb: State judiciaries, law enforcement agencies, and intelligence bodies continue active legal proceedings and monitoring targeting right-wing leadership and party infrastructure. In response, affected movements frame these actions as politically motivated lawfare designed to suppress conservative opposition.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: The Prosecutor-General defends maintaining Jair Bolsonaro's 27-year prison sentence while police probe allied political finances.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Authorities execute major financial raids, recovering millions in buried cash tied to an Orbán-era minister and investigating political figures.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Domestic intelligence services launch a renewed legal review into classifying the party as a confirmed right-wing extremist group.
